description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) processes management in a 5G NR scheduler, including HARQ process states, modes, handling, and per-UE HARQ entities.

classes.name: harq_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying HARQ process timeouts.

classes.name: harq_utils::harq_state_t
classes.description: Enumeration of possible HARQ process states.

classes.name: harq_utils::base_harq_process
classes.description: Base class for HARQ process parameters, including common attributes.

classes.name: harq_utils::dl_harq_process_impl
classes.description: Parameters specific to downlink HARQ processes.

classes.name: harq_utils::ul_harq_process_impl
classes.description: Parameters specific to uplink HARQ processes.

classes.name: harq_utils::cell_harq_repository
classes.description: Repository managing HARQ processes for UL or DL, per cell.

classes.name: dl_harq_alloc_context
classes.description: Context information for DL HARQ allocation during scheduling.

classes.name: ul_harq_alloc_context
classes.description: Context information for UL HARQ allocation during scheduling.

classes.name: dl_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Handle for accessing and updating a DL HARQ process.

classes.name: ul_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Handle for accessing and updating a UL HARQ process.

classes.name: cell_harq_manager
classes.description: Manages all HARQ processes in a cell, including creation, slot updates, and retrieval.

classes.name: unique_ue_harq_entity
classes.description: Manages HARQ processes for a single UE, including reconfiguration and HARQ process access.

methods.name: on_harq_timeout
methods.description: Callback for HARQ timeout notification.

methods.name: on_feedback_disabled_harq_timeout
methods.description: Callback for feedback-disabled HARQ timeout.

methods.name: cancel_retxs
methods.description: Cancels retransmissions for a HARQ process.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets a HARQ process.

methods.name: new_retx
methods.description: Initiates a new retransmission for a DL or UL HARQ process.

methods.name: dl_ack_info
methods.description: Updates DL HARQ process state based on ACK/NACK info.

methods.name: save_grant_params
methods.description: Stores grant parameters associated with HARQ processes.

methods.name: ul_crc_info
methods.description: Updates UL HARQ process state based on CRC feedback.

methods.name: save_grant_params
methods.description: Stores grant parameters for UL HARQ processes.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates HARQ processes based on slot progression.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE HARQ entity to the cell.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE exists in the HARQ manager.

methods.name: pending_dl_retxs
methods.description: Returns list of DL HARQ processes with pending retransmissions.

methods.name: pending_ul_retxs
methods.description: Returns list of UL HARQ processes with pending retransmissions.

methods.name: alloc_dl_harq
methods.description: Allocates a DL HARQ process for a new transmission.

methods.name: alloc_ul_harq
methods.description: Allocates a UL HARQ process for a new transmission.

methods.name: find_pending_dl_retx
methods.description: Finds a DL HARQ process pending retransmission.

methods.name: find_pending_ul_retx
methods.description: Finds a UL HARQ process pending retransmission.

methods.name: find_dl_harq_waiting_ack
methods.description: Finds a DL HARQ process waiting for ACK.

methods.name: find_ul_harq_waiting_ack
methods.description: Finds a UL HARQ process waiting for ACK.

methods.name: total_ul_bytes_waiting_ack
methods.description: Calculates total bytes in UL HARQ processes awaiting ACK.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures HARQ entity with new settings.

methods.name: has_empty_dl_harqs
methods.description: Checks for free DL HARQ processes.

methods.name: has_empty_ul_harqs
methods.description: Checks for free UL HARQ processes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Deallocates or resets the UE HARQ entity.

methods.name: dl_harq
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a specific DL HARQ process.

methods.name: ul_harq
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a specific UL HARQ process.
